budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Lemieux said the Town Meeting appropriation for the property condition assessments was $50,000, in answer to a question on what Vertex was paid.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux stated the appropriation at town meeting was $50,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Immediate repairs were put at $1,027,280 and short term repairs at $775,000 for the Primary School.
budget_items.quote: total immediate repairs would amount to $1,027,280. short term repairs came in at $775,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Immediate repairs were put at $170,297 and short term repairs at $190,496, with potential extra costs for hazardous materials abatement.
budget_items.quote: total immediate repairs would amount to $170,297 and short term repairs would cost $190,496.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Immediate repairs were put at $794,000 and short term repairs at $2,173,000 for TC Passios.
budget_items.quote: immediate repairs total $794,000. short term repairs totalled $2,173,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Summer Street bid came in $1.2 M under the office estimate.
budget_items.quote: the low bid came in $1.2 m under the office estimate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The apparent low bid from Baltazar Contractors of Ludlow was $7,105,195.
budget_items.quote: the apparent low bid was from baltazar contractors of ludlow in the amount of $7,105,195.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an accounts payable warrant of this amount.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $392,313.08.

budget_items.topic: Middle/High school HVAC and ceiling panel payments
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Bertram asked that payments on the HVAC system and ceiling panels be flagged on warrants and asked whether costs were being assumed that should not be; she would not support the final contractor payment release.
budget_items.quote: she also requested any payments on the hvac system and ceiling panels to be flagged on the warrants.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: OPEB insurance cost shares were described: the Town pays 75% and the retired employee pays 25%.
budget_items.quote: it is generally insurance coverage and the town pays 75% and the (retired) employee pays 25%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident asked what the town's bonding capacity is; Ms. Lemieux would have to look it up. No figure was given.
budget_items.quote: mr. rodgers asked what our bonding capacity is.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Bertram raised concern about the Summer Street bid coming in under budget and what adjustments would be needed; no figure was given.
budget_items.quote: she is a little concerned about the summer street project bid coming in under budget and what adjustments would be needed for that.
